lines.text: Many learners say: The bathroom is in the left.
Better: The bathroom is on the left.
On! The shop is on the right.

data.wrong: The bathroom is in the left.
data.right: The bathroom is on the left.

native.tip: Chỉ phương hướng trái/phải dùng “on the left/right”, không dùng “in.”
native.caption: Bạn có hay nói “The bathroom is in the left.” không? 😅 Trái và phải dùng “on”: “The bathroom is on the left.” Nghe cô Ama đọc rồi lặp lại nhé! Luyện thêm trong app Lexkite.
native.comment: Đáp án: “on.” Chỉ đường bằng “on the left/right” nhé. Luyện thêm miễn phí tại đây: {link}

en.tip: For left and right use “on the left/right”, not “in.”
en.caption: Do you often say this? “The bathroom is in the left.” Left and right use “on”: “The bathroom is on the left.” Listen to Ama read it, then repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
